ig_caption:
"It works on my machine": an AI chatbot on a clean machine 💻➡️💥

Same code, fresh Python container:
❌ ModuleNotFoundError: dotenv (the package only lived on my laptop)
❌ KeyError: LLM_API_KEY (the key only lived in my .env)

Your laptop quietly has packages, keys and the right Python. Production has none of them.

An app isn't a file. It's a system.

Follow along as this AI chatbot goes all the way to production 🚀

#genai #python #devops #aiapps #ai
yt_title: Python AI chatbot works on my laptop, breaks on a new machine #python
yt_description:
"It works on my machine": an AI chatbot run on a fresh python:3.12-slim container (the "clean machine"):
- ModuleNotFoundError: the dependency was never declared
- KeyError: the API key lived only in a local .env file
(The LLM call is a stub so the demo is repeatable; the key is fake.)

An app isn't a file, it's a system. This series takes one small AI chatbot from laptop to production: Docker, secrets, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD and monitoring.

Follow along.
